filo completion bash

  Prints the script that makes Tab complete filo's commands, flags, files,
  directories, tags and policy names in bash. It writes nothing itself. Load it
  in every new shell with this line in ~/.bashrc: source <(filo completion
  bash). Or save it once to ~/.local/share/bash-completion/completions/filo,
  where the bash-completion package loads it on the first Tab (save it again
  after an upgrade that changes commands).

  Completion only reads the register, never changes it, and takes no lock, so it
  works while another filo runs; with no register it completes from the disk
  alone.
